episodes.synopsis: Meet the enthusiastic customers of the bookstore who bring excitement and stimulation to Honda-san’s job.
episodes.title: The Handsome Guy is First in Line / Yaoi Girls from OVERSEAS!!!

episodes.synopsis: The long holiday is coming up, and the bookstore is swamped by a ton of shipments. How do the staff make it through?!
episodes.title: Let Me Introduce My Crazy Colleagues in This Bookstore! / Books, Written Instructions, and Me / Go! Azarashi-san

episodes.synopsis: Honda-san gives us insight into the interactions between a bookstore and a publisher.
episodes.title: A Battle Without Honor or Humanity / Lost in Manga

episodes.synopsis: It’s Honda-san’s turn to attend a customer service coaching session.
episodes.title: A Reception Training of Hell / Mission: An Outside Work-ish Job

episodes.synopsis: Honda is faced with restocking popular titles, dealing with energetic foreigners, overseeing the visit of a famous author, and mulling over questions of censorship.
episodes.title: An INQUIRY / It's a Book Signing!! Everyone Gather Up / A Fascinating Erotic Story

episodes.synopsis: Honda-san introduces Assistant Manager Majutsushi, who has the uncanny ability of knowing exactly which books to order.
episodes.title: The Man with a Secret Power / Our Fair-Day War

episodes.synopsis: Honda-san teaches us about the wonderful people known as wholesalers.
episodes.title: Tell Me! Wholesaler-san / A Networking Drinking Party for Booksellers

episodes.synopsis: The bookstore is visited by all kinds of customers, some of whom like books, and some of whom love bookstores.
episodes.title: Bookstores are so Wonderful! / The Shelves with and without Restrictions / Go for it, Azarashi-san ~The Hidden Ambition~

episodes.synopsis: Books go out of print, but under certain special circumstances, they can be brought back from the dead.
episodes.title: A Book about Life, Death, and Rebirth

episodes.synopsis: What makes a good bookseller? The answer may not be as straightforward as it seems.
episodes.title: An Outstanding Bookseller / Swapping Section Heads

episodes.synopsis: If you’ve ever worked in retail, you’ve dealt with nasty customers. But what if the good customers are worse than the bad ones?
episodes.title: The Alternate Skull-face Bookseller Honda-san / You Can Quit Your Job Whenever You Want

episodes.synopsis: Christmas is a time of madness at the bookstore. Closing time is also a time of madness at the bookstore.
episodes.title: Merry Christmas, Mr. Bookstore / It's Time to Close
